notes: This is an in-process integration test: MSC 1 boots a real RemoteAPIServer on a real loopback TCP socket and drives it with actual HTTP requests, not a pure function call. 'tokenMap' is the fixed token/role/permission table every test in this source file shares (RemoteAPIIntegrationTestCase.tokenMap); 'token' fields in requests reference it by key, except literal invalid tokens used to test auth failure. S1 covers all non-admins, not just zero-permission named tokens — guests are denied the file endpoints too.
